issue_title: Interview REVIEWS_URL reaches the rendered site config (smallest #326 slice)
problem_statement:
Interview REVIEWS_URL reaches the rendered site config (smallest #326 slice)

Child of #326 (its own candidate slice list names this slice 1: "REVIEWS_URL -> site.reviews/links block (smallest; one field, one consumer)"). Filed per the board's slice-first rule — #326 is honestly sized as bigger than one session and must not be started whole.

## Current state (verified against main 16b66ed, 2026-08-01)

- The onboarding interview collects it: `apps/mcp/app/api/[transport]/route.ts:114` — question 22, "Social proof: Google/Facebook review URL if you want a \"see all reviews\" button? -> {REVIEWS_URL}" — and the placeholder map initializes it at `route.ts:143` (`"REVIEWS_URL": ""`).
- Nothing consumes it: no preset field in `apps/mcp/content/presets/*.json` carries a reviews URL (the only "review" match in presets is the unrelated `reviewBeforeShip` list), and `apps/mcp/lib/render-site-ts.ts` has no reviews handling.
- Downstream consumers ALREADY read the field if it existed: `apps/mcp/lib/business-brain.ts:157-159` reads `meta.reviewsUrl` / `reviewsUrl` / `contact.reviewsUrl` from customer site configs (same paths exercised by `weekly-site-digest.ts`, `suggest-improvement.ts`, `local-seo-aeo-checklist.ts` and their tests).
- The template's customer-facing consumer is `reviews.link` ("Read reviews on Google" button, `chatterbuilt-template/content/site.ts` reviews block); `apps/mcp/lib/site-schema.ts:236-238` (from #324) already WARNs when the `reviews` block is absent.

So the customer answers a real question whose answer is dropped on the floor — this slice closes that loop for ONE field with existing consumers on both ends.

## Contract (session-sized)

1. A non-empty interview `{REVIEWS_URL}` answer lands in the rendered site config at a path the existing consumers read (`meta.reviewsUrl` is the first path `business-brain.ts` checks) — plumbed through the preset/render pipeline, not special-cased around it.
2. An empty/skipped answer emits NO field (no empty-string URLs in rendered config); `validate_site_config`'s existing reviews-absence WARN behavior is unchanged.
3. Config-parity sensor per #326 AC 2: interview token -> preset/render path -> rendered output, so the wiring can't silently regress.
4. Out of scope: the full `reviews` section (testimonial `items` are not collected by the interview — that is #326 slice territory, not this one); BRAND_VOICE/COLORS/PHOTOS/SERVICES_NOTES (slices 2-4); any pricing/billing surface (#17d unchanged).

Corpus-pin note for the builder: no `apps/mcp/content/docs/` additions expected, so pins 26/19/45 should not move — but verify per STATE lesson 3.

Part of #326 — closing this issue must NOT close #326.
